title: Align session prompts with the canonical RF task lifecycle
acceptance: Every start mode reads RF records with an explicit revision boundary and distinguishes stale generated output from invalid records.
After scope approval, sessions select or create a task, check prerequisites and record In progress before implementation.
Close-session finalizes records, evidence and handoff/document edits before final rendering, validation and publication.
Publication, merge and deletion instructions in the prompts and matching guidance honor separate permissions already granted.
Walk through the six reviewed failure scenarios, validate task records/board, check documentation links and run formatting.

evidence.summary: Steven approved the six-finding prompt/guidance correction on 2026-10-27. Implementation is local; publication permissions are separate.

Codex walked the six reviewed scenarios through the revised start/close instructions and ran formatting, task validation and local link checks (manual prompt review, not automated behavior tests). Its local handoff was not published; this entry replaces that reference.

resolution: Codex's six corrections were reviewed and carried into the RF-98 branch from main on 2026-10-27 with their substance intact. Their 'permissions already granted' wording now resolves to the standing grant in AGENTS.md › Delegation And Merge Policy. Publication is tracked by RF-98.
